rationale: W186 cProfile of TradingGym reset+step (240 synthetic bars) shows cumulative time dominated by SQLite persistence and gym/engine orchestration — not a pure deterministic OHLCV kernel.
Leading non-wrapper frames: gym.py:step, store.py:connect, sqlite3.Connection.commit, engine.py:step_once, store.py:add_event / add_equity_point / update_run / execute.
Pure OHLCV markers (ohlcv.py / iter_ohlcv / validate_ohlcv / _normalize_ts) did not appear among top cumulative functions; classification.pure_ohlcv_marker_cumulative_seconds_top15 == 0.0.

Porting a tiny native kernel would not address the measured hotspot (DB I/O + RiskGuard/engine side effects). A pure deterministic hotspot suitable for a no-DB/no-risk/no-agent kernel is not evidenced.
